subject: llm.py: per-model base URL for openai-compat (small change, OK?)
body: @nathan-c, C2 needs two OpenAI-compatible endpoints in one run. The candidate main target is Kimi K2.5 on Tinker (larger, so more baseline eval awareness to reduce; Qwen3-30B may hit a floor like Haiku's 0/40), while Qwen3-30B and the open judges are on Modal. OpenAICompatLLM reads one OPENAI_COMPAT_BASE_URL. Proposal, additive only: get_llm picks the base URL and key per model from OPENAI_COMPAT_ENDPOINTS='{"<model prefix>": {"base_url": ..., "key_env": ...}}' when set, falling back to OPENAI_COMPAT_BASE_URL. Existing behaviour is unchanged, with a test. May I make it, or would you rather? Separately, Abhi is weighing a budget-driven lineup: no Anthropic credits on our side and OpenAI kept near $0, so the judges would be gpt-oss-120b plus Qwen3-235B on Modal, the auditor Qwen3-235B, and held-out Kimi K2.5 in place of Sonnet 4.5. A $15 pilot (stock baseline on Qwen3-30B and Kimi) would pick the main target by baseline awareness. Not applied to configs/models.json; it needs your agreement.
